body.message:
Due to an unexpected maintenance issue that has arisen in the apartment, we regret to inform you that we are unable to accommodate your stay in the originally confirmed apartment. Unfortunately, this is an unforeseen situation beyond our control, and we truly understand how disappointing and inconvenient this may be, especially when your travel plans have already been arranged.

Please accept our apologies for the inconvenience and disruption this may cause. We genuinely regret not being able to welcome you as planned and sincerely appreciate your patience, understanding, and kind consideration during this unexpected circumstance.

To proceed with the cancellation, we kindly request you to initiate the cancellation request through the Booking.com platform. Once the request is received, we will promptly accept it from our side.

We truly value your understanding and are deeply sorry that we have had to inconvenience you at the last moment.

Thank you very much for your patience and cooperation.
